tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background (ivory in light, ink in dark). Reading surfaces for stories, Quran and Hadith.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, drawers, popovers, map popups resting on `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: search field fill, translation-compare columns, code/reference blocks, skeleton base.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Toasts and the rare inverse band. Text on it is `ink-inverse`.

tokens.name: brand-deep
tokens.usage: Evergreen band: home hero, global footer, cover block. Text on it is always `on-brand-deep` (ivory).

tokens.name: on-brand-deep
tokens.usage: Ivory text and marks on `brand-deep` (13.9:1 light, 9.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-sunken` (≥14.6:1 both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, translator and edition lines, on all three surfaces (≥5.2:1 light, ≥8.2:1 dark).

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on `surface-inverse`.

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Primary action fill, Quran evidence fill, active nav, links. Evergreen in light; sage in dark so it stays a strong figure. Text on it is `on-brand`.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `brand` fills (13.9:1 light, 9.3:1 dark).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: Restrained gold accent: geometric ornament, active timeline marker, map routes, selected-state underline. A FILL or mark only in light (2.6:1 on ivory) — never body text there; use `brass-ink`. Text on a brass fill is `ink`/`#0b171b` (6.4:1).

tokens.name: brass-ink
tokens.usage: Brass as text: scholarly-interpretation label, eyebrow labels, accent links on all surfaces (≥5.2:1 light, ≥8.0:1 dark).

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Approximate-region fill on the atlas (with hatch), genealogy generation lanes, quiet tags. Decorative fill; never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: sage-soft
tokens.usage: Selected rows, hover wash on list items and timeline lanes, highlighted ayah background.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `sage-soft` and the surfaces: tag labels, hadith evidence mark (≥6.2:1).

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Icons, historical-estimate marks and timeline ticks (≥4.2:1 light, ≥6.0:1 dark). Text only on `surface` and `surface-raised` in light.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers between sections and list rows. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary buttons, evidence label outlines): ≥3:1 on all surfaces in both themes.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; ≥8:1 on every surface in all three themes (gold in Journey).

tokens.name: ev-quran
tokens.usage: Quran evidence label: solid fill + eight-point star mark.

tokens.name: ev-hadith
tokens.usage: Authenticated Hadith label: solid 1.5px outline + filled circle mark.

tokens.name: ev-scholar
tokens.usage: Scholarly interpretation label: solid outline + half-filled circle mark.

tokens.name: ev-estimate
tokens.usage: Historical estimate label: dashed outline + ≈ mark.

tokens.name: ev-disputed
tokens.usage: Disputed label: double outline + split-diamond mark (6.0:1 light, 8.4:1 dark).

tokens.name: ev-unknown
tokens.usage: Unknown label: dotted outline + ? mark. Also unknown-date and unknown-location states.

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info text/icons (notices, 'under review'); always with a word.

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Success (saved, published). Teal-blue, off the red–green axis; always with a word or check icon.

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Warnings (licence pending, edit window closing); always with a word.

tokens.name: status-danger
tokens.usage: Errors, destructive actions, removed comments; always with a word or icon (≥5.6:1).

tokens.name: map-point
tokens.usage: Verified-point pin fill on the atlas.

tokens.name: map-region
tokens.usage: Approximate-region polygon fill (with diagonal hatch in `slate`).

tokens.name: map-route
tokens.usage: Migration/journey routes; dashed when the route is approximate.

tokens.name: map-hypothesis
tokens.usage: Historical-hypothesis outline: dotted, no fill.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind drawers, bottom sheets and modals.

tokens.name: glass-fill
tokens.usage: Frosted panel fill for Journey cards, hero panels and the progress rail. Always paired with backdrop blur; falls back to `glass-fill-strong` where blur is unsupported or reduced transparency is requested.

tokens.name: glass-fill-strong
tokens.usage: Opaque-enough glass for long text (summaries, surah lists) and the no-blur fallback. Quran and Hadith full text always sit on this or a solid surface, never on thin glass.

tokens.name: glass-stroke
tokens.usage: 1px edge of glass panels. Decorative; controls on glass still use `border`.

tokens.name: glass-highlight
tokens.usage: Inset top-edge highlight and the slow sheen sweep across glass.

tokens.name: glow-emerald
tokens.usage: Start of the timeline progress line, active node glow, primary glow. A light, never a text colour on its own.

tokens.name: glow-teal
tokens.usage: Middle of the progress line; ambient background glow.

tokens.name: glow-cyan
tokens.usage: Hover edge light on glass cards; focus ring in Journey. Use sparingly — one cyan accent per viewport.

tokens.name: glow-gold
tokens.usage: End of the progress line, active-node ring, geometric motifs, era dividers.

families.sans: "IBM Plex Sans", "IBM Plex Sans Arabic", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: display-xl
styles.sample: Explore the story. Follow the evidence.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page titles: prophet profile, story title, surah title. 32px/38px on mobile.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: Narratives are written in calm, plain sentences and cite every claim.
styles.usage: Long-form story and methodology prose; max measure `measure-reading`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Translations are shown with translator and edition.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Evidence labels, buttons-sm, tags, legend items.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase section kickers in `brass-ink`. Latin only — never uppercase-transform Arabic.

styles.name: quran-ayah
styles.usage: Quran Arabic in the reader and verse cards, dir=rtl, lang=ar. User-scalable 24–48px. Never letter-spaced, never italic, never truncated.

styles.name: quran-inline
styles.usage: Quran Arabic inside evidence drawers and compact cards.

styles.name: naskh-text
styles.usage: Hadith Arabic matn and isnad, tafsir Arabic.

styles.name: arabic-ui
styles.usage: Arabic interface text (IBM Plex Sans Arabic) when the UI language is ar. Line height is taller than Latin body.

styles.name: reference
styles.usage: Citation chips, canonical numbers, numbering-system notes, admin IDs.

tokens.name: space-2

tokens.name: space-3

tokens.name: space-9

tokens.name: radius-sm

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.usage: Map popups, menus, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer

tokens.name: shadow-glow-active
